title: Admit exact P2-006 data-governance validator
businessObjective: Permit independent machine verification of the planned P2-006 static data-minimisation and retention contract without broadening command execution or implementing data behavior.
technicalObjective: Add one shell-free exact mapping for `node tests/data-governance/validate-data-minimisation-retention-contract-v1.mjs`, focused near-miss rejection coverage, and accurate verifier-policy documentation; do not create or execute the future product validator.
assumptions: GOV-050 fixes one byte-for-byte future validator command; the P2-006 schema, policy, module, validator, and product documentation remain absent and outside GOV-051.
The verifier already provides a shell-false fixed-argument process runner; this task may add only one literal mapping and focused self-tests.
No data, provider, storage, retention action, queue, workflow, AI invocation, external call, product contract, or production operation is authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the exact literal `node tests/data-governance/validate-data-minimisation-retention-contract-v1.mjs` is newly admitted and maps to `node` with exactly one fixed repository-relative path argument through the existing `shell: false` runner.

Self-tests accept the exact literal and reject leading, doubled, and trailing whitespace; extra arguments; chaining and shell operators; redirects; command substitution; alternate and sibling paths; dot-path and traversal forms; absolute paths; and Windows path separators.

No generic Node or test-path pattern, arbitrary argument parsing, shell execution, mutation-capable command, P2-006 product validator/schema/policy/module, SDK, storage/provider behavior, data access, retention action, queue, workflow, AI invocation, external call, or production behavior is introduced.
Verification policy and a durable risk entry identify the exact admission, its non-product scope, and the remaining P2-006 implementation and independent-verification boundary.
Packet-authorized deterministic checks pass and implementation evidence is ready for separate independent Sol QA; the implementer does not run `verify:task` or act as completion authority.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-GOV-051 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: fixed argument and shell-free process inspection
solEscalationTriggers: Any generic/pattern admission, arbitrary arguments, shell execution, mutation-capable command, P2-006 product implementation, data/provider/storage/lifecycle behavior, external call, or scope outside the exact verifier mapping requires a separate approved packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the exact P2-006 validator mapping, focused self-tests, verification-policy statement, GOV-051 risk entry, lifecycle record, and GOV-051 evidence; preserve GOV-050 design/evidence, the P2-006 backlog packet, terminal records, product paths, canonical sources, immutable snapshots, protected history, and external systems.
